About Amsterdam Pop-ups

Amsterdam Pop-ups is a weekly guide to the city that leads with pop-ups: pop-up restaurants, shops and supper clubs, plus one-off events, markets, small gigs, film and shows. A new edition goes live every Monday.

The whole city

We look well beyond the canal ring, so Noord, Nieuw-West and Zuidoost get as much attention as Centrum and De Pijp. If it only runs for a night, a weekend or a few weeks, from a popup bakery to a one-night gig, we want to know about it.

Checked at the source

Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page: date, time, venue and price. Plans do change, though, so give the organiser's link a quick look before you head out.

Independent

We're a small, independent guide made by locals. Nobody pays to be listed.

Tell us about a pop-up

Spotted a pop up we've missed, or running one yourself? Send it through our tip form. Organisers can list their own event there too. You can also email hello@amsterdampopups.com.

Start with this week's guide, with a map and filters, or read this week as a plain list. How we handle your data is on our Privacy page.
